trans-unit.source: This module provides administration operations for the Solr file indexer.

The file indexer items assign the files of the file collections enabled for Solr to sites, languages and metadata records. They are built by the console command solr_file_indexer:item-queue-worker and are required to index files. The Solr index queue and the Solr index are not changed here.
There are no items. Run the console command solr_file_indexer:item-queue-worker to build them.

Deleting the items removes the assignment of all files. Files are not indexed until solr_file_indexer:item-queue-worker has run again and the index queue for sys_file_metadata has been re-initialized.
Files are not indexed until the items are built again. Really delete all items?
File indexer items deleted. Run solr_file_indexer:item-queue-worker and re-initialize the index queue for sys_file_metadata.
